2026/10/05 | 11:07 AM » shroom trip report 1

cw: magic mushrooms, unreality, time distortion/dilation

on 2025/26/02, i experienced my first psilocybin trip. text in orange will signify things that i said during the experience. text in green will signify things that my friend who was present at the time said.

i'd bought magic mushroom chocolate from a vendor and ate 6 pieces of it—definitely more than recommended for a first trip, as each piece was 0.33g of psilocybin. i was excited, to say the least, about this endeavour.

im so pumped for this high ngl like some people end up hyper paranoid and convinced that other people want to kill them and shit like that. i hope to collect this experience and put it in a jar

my motivation for wanting to experience a shroom trip was simple. i was curious about what it could reveal to me about myself.

people say that shrooms can make you realize all the lies youve been telling yourself so i wonder 1) what things ill realize about myself if anything and 2) what things fictional characters would realize because this would be a fantastic avenue for character exploration/study

here was the plan: i was going to take it ahead of time before a call with a friend, and that friend would liveblog my high in a group chat. i was also going to be playing minecraft during the whole ordeal.

---

8:22 PM: at some point i started working on organizing some storage chests in the server and kept getting lost in the sauce.

bro so zooted he sat in place for like a straight seven seconds staring at his chest. bro does NOT know where he is

8:52 PM: i remember realizing it was starting to kick in proper when i was looking at some discord messages; i was starting to see colorful visual distortions in the text, which was also moving. i also had the distinct feeling of disgust for the lingering taste of shroom chocolate in my mouth. it hadn't tasted that great.

bro says reality is very reality right now. he's like to throw up

also that his mouth feels like if anything touches it he might vomit

he mentioned that while i was making ramen

i am currently eating ramen as i witness ol boy's misery

9:03 PM: my speech started to get more stilted and stiff as time went on. i wasn't really thinking of what to say; i was just saying whatever came to my mind. random shit like, dead child. oh that's awful

these are associations that are pleasurable

is that your way of saying that you enjoy my company?

i do enjoy your company

9:29 PM: shortly after the above interaction i went into the chat and typed sephirogh, and then reportedly giggled my ass off. i think the connection i made was that fanon pre-nibelheim sephiroth tends to talk in a really stilted manner not unlike how i was talking at the moment.

i also started feeling like i was noticing patterns in existence. that i was making some kind of connections. what i was realizing, i couldn't tell you.

9:32 PM: things started devolving, and my speech started turning into various one-word sentences. in the minecraft server chat, i started just. saying shit. i was also saying shit irl. in the below image, i'm the player named zakkuras.

im trying to figure out the pattern between fear and aossociaiton and now that im verbalizing them it feels obvvious

hm

comprehension

9:39 PM: my friend started transcribing the various things i was saying because i just started stream-of-consciousness rambling at some point.

alarming. sleeping through this night. bees. value. karnage went to sleep, sweet dreams. oh source berries. star...backpack. hamter? oh i like hamter. backpack. bad. feeling. oh nonononono. hampter? no. fungus psychidelic. comprehension. mycelium. bad feeling. feeling bad. no. what am i supposed to do about it? hm. pattern. hm. pleasurable. association. arcane mycelium. brown. bees bees. mycelium. hunter. value. transcribe. ohh sourceberry. association. pattern. association. dragonfly. yeahhh dragonfly. value. association value. feeling. feeeling feeling feeling. what are you supposed to do about it? oh moo. caught fire! ohh sorry sorry. what are you supposed to do about it?

fear. oh patterns patterns patterns. feelings. stone. im sorry im sorry im sorry. psychidelic. oh hes vanished vanished feelings. i am its not funny anymore. reality. association. value? reality. uhhh psychidelic towel in. im sorry.

you don't have to apologize

no. feeling. reality. im sorry. im going to feel bad about this aren't i?

9:42 PM: my friend started describing the state i was in for the sake of my other friend, who couldn't make it to the call.

bro is talking like, realization by realization

like breaking down things to bare thoughts

it's pretty interesting actually

momentary breakthroughs of full cognitive thought where there's a full sentence then returning to the breaking down thoughts

9:51 PM: i really just stopped making sense at this point.

it's better for me to assume that you're comprehending. uncertainty feeling

association, comprehension. these two aren't the same

axolotl. association. yes, i want this to happen more often! funny funny.

alert. noooo nonononono. vlaue. pattern. alert? void void void void. nooo. mmnmmn. random movie. okay okay. mmnmmn. okay. alert alert. feeling value judgement.

there's dimensions of alertness

reality confirmed

wanna leave a message for [other friend] when he wakes up?

hmm. tamagotchi.

eventually i just... closed my laptop for reasons i don't remember. my friend had temporarily stepped away from the computer/phone to do something, and i guess i forgot that they would be back, because i ended up hopping off call and getting into bed.

things really started getting loopy after that. here's what i had to say the morning afterward:

oh yeah so after i hopped off call my trip when wildly bad LMFAOOO my sense of time and reality got unraveled and like

idk how to describe it but i was experiencing time like it was being infinitely divided and it felt like everything was stretching out for an eternity and i was stuck in the high desperately trying to get out

also i think i took off my pants at some point. not sure why that happened. and then i put them back on. but i couldve hallucinated that

i was cycling through certainty and uncertainty and duality and jumping around word associations that got me stuck in a loop where it was like, the more certain i became that i was back in reality i undermined it by going "but that must mean that i'm NOT back in reality because being too certain is a sign that it's not actually true" and it just kept looping

at some point i feared i broke my sense of reality forever and that i ruined my growth as a person and that i would disappoint everyone that i knew

i was basically imagining things but so extremely vividly that i thought i was actually experiencing them

after i hopped off call it was like i was experiencing slices of time in an eternity and id look back at the clock on my phone and see only a few minutes had passed

like time got whittled down to an atomic level and i was experiencing every atom in excruciating detail

in summary: i experienced a lot of time dilation after turning off the lights and getting into bed. i felt like i was going to be stuck in the high forever because of how long slices of time were stretching out to be. i recall checking the time frequently and being shocked at how slowly it was moving as i waited to get out of the high. it was absolutely terrifying. i would also absolutely do it again, because it was interesting as hell.

after this experience, i tried to get high on shrooms a couple more times (albeit with smaller doses). unfortunately, i believe some of the medication that i'm on interfered with the effects, so i never really got high like that again. i only experienced nausea after attempting to eat more chocolates or trying to make shroom tea unfortunately.

all in all, it was a pretty wild foray into the world of magic mushrooms, especially for my first time getting high on psilocybin. i would absolutely not recommend taking how much i took for a first trip. i also didn't really get anything out of it aside from being able to collect an interesting experience as far as i'm aware, but i still find value in that.

when i got back onto the minecraft server, by the way, i had absolutely no fucking clue where i was on the map and how i got there. i think i just wandered in a random direction while i was tripping and got lost. at some point i had also broken my chests and the items within them despawned, which was a tragedy. not sure how much shit i lost.
